new_value: Fixed in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py: render_post now validates timeout_s (finite non-bool number, 0 < timeout_s <= MAX_ROLLCALL_TIMEOUT_S=604800) and rejects with 4.00 Bad Request. Restored the slot-limit machinery the bead presupposed but was missing from this tree: MAX_ROLLCALLS=256, _prune_expired() called before capacity check, 5.03 Service Unavailable when full (new ids only; re-POST to existing id still allowed). Verified: timeout_s=2**63/inf/nan all rejected, nothing stored; 257th distinct rollcall gets 5.03 at len==256; expired entries pruned. 65 tests pass incl. new TestRollcallPostValidation.
